payload.acceptance_criteria:
ruleset.json holds a rule with an anchor for the core split, each named Agentic Kanban rule, orch status, clean up after yourself, the settings and CLAUDE.md lessons and the reread lesson.
The quiet-window rule is replaced by the core split rule.
orch doctor fails when an owner rule in the Orchestration rules section has no matching ruleset rule.
payload.description:
## Context
When the orchestrator kit checks its rules, I want ruleset.json to match today's workspace rules in ../ARCHITECTURE.md, so orch doctor fails on a rule that lives only there. Missing or stale on 2026-11-19: quiet-window (replaced by the core split), Agentic Kanban ids, orch status and state lines, clean up after yourself, settings and CLAUDE.md edits need the owner in the worker's window, and rule changes reach running sessions only after a reread. Orchestrator order 2026-11-19 20:16 UTC, before 0.47.0.
payload.title: Bring the orchestrator kit rules up to the workspace rules

payload.acceptance_criteria:
orch approve and orch decide refuse when CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is unset, unknown in the orch session store, or names a session other than Orchestrator.
Every call, accepted or refused, is logged with the session id and name.
orch doctor reports an approval or decision entry not written by the Orchestrator session.
payload.description:
## Context
When a session runs orch approve or orch decide, I want the command to refuse unless the calling session is the registered Orchestrator, so no other session records an approval in the owner's name. repair found plain Bash allow rules let any session do it. Orchestrator orders 2026-11-19 20:27 and 20:29 UTC. Limits: a process that copies or exports the Orchestrator's session id passes; the call log and repair's scan are the backstop.
payload.title: Refuse orch approve and decide outside the Orchestrator session

payload.description:
## Context
When a lane worktree writes a tracker event, the ledger redirect sends it into the main checkout's pending file, even during another session's landing window. On 2026-11-19 a review and claim from dev-vault-checks landed in basicly main at 20:16 UTC, and another at 20:27 UTC. Finding for the cleanup or landing-lock work; no fix in this record.
payload.title: A lane's tracker writes reach main during a landing window
